review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Verify the scope, explicit retirement confirmation, and outcome of legacy lock maintenance
review.notes: Use disposable state. The retirement confirmation is required because even a successful flock cannot exclude an old writer that has opened the old inode but has yet to lock it. A held-lock fixture covers defensive skipping. Tests do not claim to detect every legacy writer.

cases.description: Doctor reports legacy participant profile locks without modifying them
cases.setup: Disposable HOME with matching empty locks, a held lock, profile data, shard locks, and lookalike files and links.
cases.action: Collect the doctor row and render it in the structured report. Reject combinations of the dedicated maintenance flag with other modes.
cases.expected: The recommendation counts only matching owned empty regular files with one link. The report remains read-only and incompatible modes exit before making any changes.

cases.description: Dedicated doctor maintenance cleans eligible legacy profile locks after explicit confirmation
cases.setup: Disposable HOME with eligible fixtures, one held lock, a matching old JSON, active shard storage, and unrelated files. Use simulated confirmation inputs and keep the real home outside the test.
cases.action: Decline retirement, then confirm it. Check the remaining lock, release it and retry until the report is clear.
cases.expected: Declining changes nothing. Confirming removes eligible idle legacy locks, reports the held lock as remaining and returns a nonzero result for partial cleanup. After release the retry succeeds and a further run is a no-op. Old and current profile data, shard locks and lookalike entries are preserved.
